title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man
paraphrase: Mars beings participate in the formation of the sentient or feeling soul.
interpretation_qualification: This soul member has a wider meaning than the everyday faculty of feeling.

title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man | Dritter Vortrag — Das Hereinwirken geistiger Wesenheiten in den Menschen
paraphrase: Steiner names Mercury in the development of the intellectual soul and separately as teacher of initiates.
interpretation_qualification: An earlier paragraph in the same lecture assigns intellectuality to Venus beings.

title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man
paraphrase: Jupiter beings stir the consciousness soul, with help from a category of Venus beings.
interpretation_qualification: The source emphasizes that planetary tasks change through evolution.

title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man
paraphrase: Steiner assigns Venus beings a role as Spirit-Self is drawn into the consciousness soul.
interpretation_qualification: This relation is distinct from Jupiter’s contribution to developing that soul member.

title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man | Dritter Vortrag — Das Hereinwirken geistiger Wesenheiten in den Menschen
paraphrase: Steiner names Jupiter beings as earlier contributors to the etheric body and later to the consciousness soul.
interpretation_qualification: The earlier role is specified in the lecture’s own esoteric human chronology, distinct from GA 13’s Old Sun account.

title: Third Lecture — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings on Man | Dritter Vortrag — Das Hereinwirken geistiger Wesenheiten in den Menschen | Lecture Three — GA 102. The Influence of Spiritual Beings Upon Man (1961)
paraphrase: Steiner describes Venus beings as endowing humans with intellectuality.
interpretation_qualification: Both checked English versions and German agree on the name. This is recorded separately from Mercury and the intellectual soul in §§23–24.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Jupiter’s grace is associated with the will impulse in free thinking.
interpretation_qualification: This is the 1923 account of planets enabling human freedom.

title: Planetary Spirits that Determine Destiny and Liberate Humanity I — GA 228. The Development of Human Consciousness
paraphrase: Saturn’s retention of cosmic memory and its contribution to free human remembering are related in GA 228.
interpretation_qualification: The journey account adds an explicit return-stage metamorphosis.
